calls.statement: SELECT tier, is_current, count(*) AS versions, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, min(valid_from), max(valid_from), min(valid_to), max(valid_to) FROM dim_member GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT count(*) AS n_current_rows, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS distinct_ids, sum(CASE WHEN valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_ended, (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_current_ids, (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0)) AS ids_without_current FROM dim_member WHERE is_current

calls.statement:
SELECT s.tier AS staged_tier, s.is_current AS staged_current, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT s.member_id) AS ids, min(s.valid_from), max(s.valid_from), sum(CASE WHEN m.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS key_in_dim, sum(CASE WHEN c.member_id IS NOT NULL AND c.tier <> s.tier THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS differs_from_current
FROM stg_member_updates s LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = s.member_key LEFT JOIN dim_member c ON c.member_id = s.member_id AND c.is_current
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT count(*) AS overlapping_pairs FROM dim_member a JOIN dim_member b ON a.member_id=b.member_id AND a.member_key<b.member_key AND a.valid_from<=b.valid_to AND b.valid_from<=a.valid_to

SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS ids, sum(CASE WHEN member_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_ids, sum(CASE WHEN join_date > DATE '2026-10-08' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS future_join, max(join_date) AS max_join FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier='Gold'
